name: ai-autocomplete
title: AI Autocomplete
description: An email-style text box that asks for a completion when typing pauses and shows the next words as grey ghost text after the caret. Tab accepts it all, the right arrow takes one word, and Escape dismisses it.
use: A writing or reply field should help people finish sentences while leaving them fully in control.
avoid: It leans on Tab and arrow keys, the touch accept buttons are small, and you must plug in a real suggester.
a11y: Tab, arrow and Escape all work and suggestions are announced live, but the text box has no visible focus ring. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A plain dark compose box with To and Subject lines above, then a borderless multi-line text area. The typed text is white, the suggested continuation trails it in grey and ends in a small outlined Tab key hint, with Accept, Word and Dismiss shortcuts below.
behaves: When typing pauses at the end of the text, a suggestion fades in word by word in grey. Tab takes the whole thing, the right arrow takes one word, Escape clears it, and typing matching letters leaves the rest in place.
customise: Props set the current and default text, a change handler, the suggest function, pause delay, placeholder and accessible label; ghost styling and key handling are fixed.
weight: light: One textarea plus a mirrored text layer; it wakes only after a typing pause.
